The '''Grohl sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Lying near the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], the Grohl sector was home to [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] such as the [[Felacatian]]s and the [[Porporite]]s. Significant locations in the sector included [[Sucharme]], [[Korseg IV]], [[Hikil]], and the [[Koiogra system/Legends|Koiogra system]].

==History==
Early in the Grohl [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] history, it was under the control of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="TEA" />

The sector later became a flashpoint for a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict when the [[Porporite]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the Grohl sector's [[Porpor system/Legends|Porpor system]],<ref name="TEA" /> became widely addicted to [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] introduced to them by [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] traders. The drug produced violent rages in the formerly peaceful Porporites, who began to raid neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. In [[4800 BBY]], [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were hired by the Neimoidians in response, resulting in the [[Speciecide|extermination]] of the Porporites. The Gank forces continued their rampage in a full-scale war against the entire [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[4775 BBY]], the [[Gank Massacres]] ended after the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] finally defeated the Ganks.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the sector was controlled by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="TEA" />

After its return to Republic control, the Neimoidian-dominated [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] became influential in the sector. By the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the Federation had controlling interest in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sucharme]]'s agricultural corporations. Under Federation control, Sucharme's economy was disrupted as the Neimoidian cartel turned the planet into an exporter of raw materials to other worlds dominated by the Federation. Local protests on Sucharme resulted in a full-scale invasion by the Federation's [[Trade Defense Force|military forces]].<ref name="EGWAC8" />

The local [[Grohl Sector Defense Force]], after having battled [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the rimward parts of the sector and ended a [[Civil war on Ostega|civil war]] on [[Ostega]], responded by ousting the Federation forces from Sucharme. The [[Grohl Liberation Front]] was also formed in response, an organization which engaged in a campaign of sabotage against the Trade Federation. One Defense Force officer, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]], resigned his commission to join the Grohl Liberation Front.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

Enough fighting took place in the Grohl sector during the Clone Wars that, by the end of the war, the sector was littered with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] left inert after the Separatist surrender. The newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], however, did not bring freedom to the sector. The Empire sent an invasion force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] turned [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to Sucharme, ordered to eliminate planetary leaders and nationalize the planet's commerce. Kligson, the hero of Grohl sector who had served the Republic as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in its [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], was gunned down by his own forces when he tried to countermand their orders. Rescued by Liberation Front agents and rebuilt as a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]], Kligson briefly led guerrilla efforts against the Empire in the sector from the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] dubbed [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]]. After a few months, however, Kligson and his moon left the sector.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Grohl sector was contested between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agents [[Diskio Khzrry|Diskio]] and [[K'lial Khzrry]], a [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] couple, operated in the region.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> The [[Battle of Korseg IV]] was also fought in the sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

Years later, [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] held control of the sector.<ref name="TEA" />
